# Outside Online

> > Outside Online is the premier outdoor media brand covering adventure sports, gear reviews, training guides, and outdoor culture across running, cycling, hiking, climbing, and wilderness exploration.

Outside Online encompasses multiple specialty publications including RUN (running and ultramarathon training), Velo (cycling and racing), and comprehensive gear reviews. The platform offers Outside+ membership with GPS apps, training plans, and access to 15+ outdoor brands, along with the Outside Days summer festival and industry conference.

## Key Topics

- Running and ultramarathon training
- Outdoor gear reviews and equipment
- Trail running and road running
- Hiking and backpacking
- Cycling technical support
- Marathon training plans
- Adventure journalism
- Camping and outdoor cooking
- Waterproof boots and hiking gear
- Headlamps and outdoor equipment
- Winter sports
- Outside Magazine classics
- Lennard Zinn technical FAQ
- Boston Marathon coverage
- Public lands and conservation

## Main Platforms & Subscriptions

- [Outside Magazine](https://outsideonline.com): Main homepage covering travel, sports, gear, fitness, and outdoor culture
- [RUN | Powered by Outside](https://run-staging.outsideonline.com): Running-focused site with gear reviews, training, and ultrarunning content
- [Outside Plus Subscription](https://outsideonline.com/outsideplus-osf25): Outside+ subscription with GPS apps, streaming, and 15+ outdoor brands
- [Login with Outside](https://accounts.outsideonline.com): Unified login for Outside, Gaia GPS, and Trailforks accounts
- [About RUN Magazine](https://run.outsideonline.com/general/run-powered-by-outside): About RUN magazine: training, racing, and running community for all levels
- [About Velo/Peloton](https://velo.outsideonline.com/about-peloton): About Velo/Peloton cycling magazine: racing, tech, and bike culture
- [Outside Days Festival](https://outsidedays.outsideonline.com/about): About Outside Days summer festival and industry conference

## Running Training & Plans

- [Training Plans for Runners](https://run.outsideonline.com/collection/best-training-plans-for-runners): Expert running training plans for 5K, 10K, half marathon, and marathon
- [Running Your First Ultramarathon](https://run.outsideonline.com/training/training-plans/ultra-distances/running-your-first-ultramarathon): Five-rule guide for marathoners transitioning to ultramarathon racing
- [All Running Content](https://run.outsideonline.com/all): Complete running content: workouts, gear reviews, and training advice
- [Road Running Coverage](https://run.outsideonline.com/road): Road running coverage including marathons and U.S. Half Championships
- [Running Gear Reviews](https://run.outsideonline.com/gear): Running gear reviews covering road shoes, trail shoes, and maintenance

## Outdoor Adventure & Beginner Guides

- [Adventure News & Politics](https://outsideonline.com/outdoor-adventure): Outdoor adventure news covering exploration, survival, and avalanche rescue
- [How to Plan a Backpacking Trip](https://outsideonline.com/outdoor-adventure/hiking-and-backpacking/how-to-plan-backpacking-trip): Seven-step backpacking planning process by Andrew Skurka
- [Beginner's Guide to Camp Cooking](https://outsideonline.com/food/camp-cooking-beginners-guide): Beginner's guide to camp cooking with meal planning and gear tips
- [Beginner's Fishing Guide](https://outsideonline.com/outdoor-adventure/water-activities/how-to-start-fishing): Beginner fishing guide covering gear, licenses, and spinner techniques
- [Inside the Life of a Mount Everest Guide](https://outsideonline.com/outdoor-adventure/everest/guide-mount-everest): Decade-long Everest guide shares high-altitude guiding realities

## Gear Reviews & Shopping

- [Camp Kitchen Gear](https://shop.outsideonline.com/collections/camp-kitchen): Camp kitchen gear reviews and buying guides from Outside Magazine
- [Packs and Bags](https://shop.outsideonline.com/collections/packs-and-bags): Packs and bags gear reviews with hiking and outdoor equipment guides

## Editorial & Culture

- [Outside Classics Collection](https://outsideonline.com/collection/outside-classics): Curated collection of Outside's greatest long-form journalism pieces
- [Videos Archive](https://outsideonline.com/video): Video content featuring detour guides, overlanding, and adventure series
- ['The Hidden Wisdom of Animals' Book Review](https://outsideonline.com/culture/books-media/hidden-wisdom-animals): Book review of Kate Siber's 'The Hidden Wisdom of Animals'
- [RE:PUBLIC Nonprofit Newsroom Launch](https://outsideonline.com/culture/books-media/nonprofit-newsroom-republic-public-lands): Christopher Keyes launches RE:PUBLIC nonprofit for public lands journalism

## Cycling Technical FAQ

- [Gear Choice & Di2 Technical FAQ](https://velo.outsideonline.com/gear/tech-wearables/zinn-technical-faq-gear-choice-for-optimal-efficiency-dead-di2-mavic-10-11-switch): Lennard Zinn answers gear efficiency, Di2, and Mavic compatibility questions
- [12-Speed Components Compatibility](https://velo.outsideonline.com/road/road-racing/technical-faq-compatibility-of-12-speed-components): Shimano and SRAM 12-speed component cross-compatibility guide
- [Adapting Bike Fit as You Age](https://velo.outsideonline.com/gear/technical-faq-adapting-bike-fit-as-you-age): Bike fit adjustments for aging cyclists and flexibility loss
- [Factory Chain Lube FAQ](https://velo.outsideonline.com/road/road-racing/technical-faq-should-you-leave-the-factory-lube-on-a-new-chain): Chain lubrication debate: factory lube vs wax from Zero Friction Cycling
- [Fixing Shimano Derailleur Clutch](https://velo.outsideonline.com/road/road-racing/technical-faq-fixing-a-sticky-clutch-on-a-shimano-rear-derailleur): How to service Shimano Shadow+ clutch on RX and MTB derailleurs
- [12-Speed Gearing Options](https://velo.outsideonline.com/gear/technical-faq-12-speed-gearing-options-cassette-compatibility-anticoagulants): 12-speed gearing, cassette compatibility, and cycling on blood thinners
- [Riding on Blood Thinners](https://velo.outsideonline.com/road/road-racing/technical-faq-more-on-riding-while-on-blood-thinners): Cycling safety considerations for riders on anticoagulant medication
